title: Phoning about a summer job
instructionsHu: Egy balatoni fagylaltozó nyári diákmunkára keres valakit. Hívd fel az angol tulajdonost, mutatkozz be, mondd el, miért lennél jó a munkára, és tudd meg a részleteket. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: You have seen an advertisement for a summer job at an ice-cream shop in Siófok, at Lake Balaton. The owner is a British man who has lived in Hungary for some years but does not speak Hungarian well. You phone him to ask about the job.
situation.candidateRole: You are a student who would like to get the summer job.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is Mr Harris, the owner of the ice-cream shop.
goals: Say why you are calling and why you are interested in the job.
Tell him about your experience and skills, for example languages or working with people.
Ask about the working hours and the pay.
Arrange a day when you can come in for a trial day.
situation.examinerOpening: Hello, Harris Ice Cream, Tom speaking.

followUpQuestions: Oh, great. Have you ever worked with customers before?
Well, it's quite hard work, especially at weekends. Is there anything you'd like to know about the job?
Could you come in for a trial day next week? Which day would suit you?

usefulPhrases.en: I'm calling about the summer job advertisement.
usefulPhrases.hu: A nyári munkáról szóló hirdetés miatt telefonálok.

usefulPhrases.en: I helped out at my uncle's café last year.
What would my working hours be?
How much is the pay per hour?
I'm looking forward to meeting you.
